sources.title: aaarchitha7/kcat-km-model-v7 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a starter model for the joint kcat–Km task. You train a model on your computer and upload it to a public Hugging Face (HF) model repository. Then you submit that repository to the Leak CURBER leaderboard. A free HF account is enough. Predict both base-10 logged values. Do not exponentiate ...

sources.title: Danish-777/kcat-km-v7 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Predicts log10(kcat) and log10(Km) from an enzyme sequence and a substrate SMILES. CPU only.
